exports.barrel: not edited; A02 should add: export * from "./metrics/intervals/intervals.js"

semantics.censored: null or non-finite start/end; excluded from arithmetic, counted
semantics.clockError: known end < known start; excluded, counted
semantics.union: overlapping and touching intervals merge; evidenceIds deduplicated; totalMs null if no valid interval (lower bound when censored/clockErrors > 0)
semantics.sum: plain sum of valid durations (overlaps counted per interval, e.g. agent time); excluded = censored + clockErrors; totalMs null if no valid interval
semantics.overlap: null if either input is censored or a clock error; else max(0, min(end) - max(start))
semantics.closeOpenIntervalAt: closes a known-start/open-end interval at asOfMs (branch start -> now), label suffixed '@as-of'; otherwise returns the input unchanged
